verdict.rationale: The evidence pack says only that llamafile supports GGUF models. It never mentions quantization, and FP8, INT4, GPTQ and AWQ appear nowhere, so no documented support for loading these quantized formats can be credited. Inferring quantization support from GGUF would rely on outside knowledge.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ
